objections.finding: R2 prose says 'falling back to the raw currentModelCode from session metadata if available' — this is ambiguous. Fallback only fires when key is 'default' or missing.

summary.overall_assessment: BA spec is thorough and accurate. All four dimensions verified against source code. Root cause is mechanically certain (division arithmetic). The fix shape (per-model lookup + thread resolved denominator through getContextWarning) is minimal and targeted. Technical Hints provide implementation-ready code. Acceptance criteria AC1-AC5 are verifiable and cover: 1M non-degenerate percentage (AC1), non-1M no regression (AC2), warning thresholds preserved (AC3), lookup coverage (AC4), 'default' key fallthrough (AC5).
